components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single dominant action on a surface.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--lexync-color-brand-primary); color: var(--lexync-color-white); font: 600 0.875rem/1.2 var(--lexync-type-family-body); transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--lexync-color-brand-primary-hover); } .ds-button-primary:active { background: var(--lexync-color-brand-primary-active); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: var(--lexync-focus-width) solid var(--lexync-focus-color); outline-offset: var(--lexync-focus-offset); }

components.name: Select Field
components.description: A native semantic select with deliberate Lexync chrome.
components.css: .ds-select-label { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: var(--lexync-color-ink); font: 600 0.875rem/1.2 var(--lexync-type-family-body); } .ds-select { min-height: 44px; appearance: none; padding: 0 42px 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--lexync-color-border-strong); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--lexync-color-surface); color: var(--lexync-color-ink); font: 500 1rem/1.2 var(--lexync-type-family-body); } .ds-select:focus-visible { outline: var(--lexync-focus-width) solid var(--lexync-focus-color); outline-offset: var(--lexync-focus-offset); }

components.name: Product Navigation
components.description: Quiet task navigation with a clear current destination.
components.html: LibraryReview
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 8px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--lexync-color-surface-subtle); } .ds-nav-item { padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 12px; color: var(--lexync-color-ink-muted); font: 600 0.875rem/1.2 var(--lexync-type-family-body); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: var(--lexync-color-ink); background: var(--lexync-color-surface); } .ds-nav-current { color: var(--lexync-color-brand-primary-active); background: var(--lexync-color-surface-strong); }

narrative.overview: Lexync turns something noticed in real reading into material worth keeping. Public surfaces make that transformation tangible, while product surfaces stay calm, dense, and task-first.
keyCharacteristics: Fox-led identity with product-derived learning visuals
Restrained sky layering with decisive blue actions and a warm ember accent

rules.name: Purple Has a Job
rules.body: Purple marks identity, the primary action, focus, or current selection.

rules.name: Task Scale
rules.body: Authenticated web and extension UI use fixed sizes.

rules.name: Earned Elevation
rules.body: A shadow must explain stacking or interaction.

dos: Show the real capture, synchronization, and practice relationship on public surfaces.
Keep the active Learning Language visually attached to the task it scopes.
Style every select, field, menu, focus ring, empty state, and validation state as one control system.
donts: Do not resemble a generic AI-generated editorial landing page.
Do not ship a default unstyled HTML application or browser-default dropdown.
Do not build a compressed dashboard from repeated bordered cards.
Do not allow the desktop header to wrap or misalign.
